title: Approve a sarcopenia drug that improves strength and physical function

concept.text: Treat age-related sarcopenia with a medicine that improves patients' functional ability, rather than muscle mass alone. Bimagrumab increased lean mass in a randomized trial but did not significantly improve its primary physical-performance endpoint. Proposed completion test: FDA or EMA approval specifically for sarcopenia, following a pivotal randomized trial in consensus-defined patients showing a clinically meaningful improvement in strength and mobility or disability over at least 12 months. Test set by: Regulators would set approval requirements. EWGSOP2 supplies a diagnostic framework emphasizing low strength, confirmation by low muscle quantity/quality, and physical performance for severity; the 12-month duration is editorial. Overlaps: ORT-06, PHA-09, LON-03. Sources given: [EWGSOP2 consensus definition](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/mid/EMS80409/) ; [Randomized bimagrumab trial in sarcopenia](https://jamanetwork.com/journals/jamanetworkopen/fullarticle/2771858).
